title: Local finiteness of Hⁿ⌞M and of the weight of an integer multiplicity representation
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be any set, and let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an integer multiplicity representation in U (an IMRep U n). That is: M = R.carrier is Borel with M ⊆ U; θ = R.mult : ℝ^P → ℕ is Borel with θ ≥ 1 on M; and ∫_{M∩K} θ dH^n < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U, where H^n = μHE[n]. Let μ_R = R.measure = θ·(H^n⌞M), i.e. (H^n⌞M).withDensity θ. Then for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P with K ⊆ U: H^n(M ∩ K) < ∞ and μ_R(K) < ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (K : Set (Euclid P)), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (R.carrier ∩ K) ≠ ∞ ∧ R.measure K ≠ ∞
